output.name: code-node-string-escaping-in-sdk-source
output.description: Code node JS written inside SDK template literals lost or mangled backslash escapes, producing invalid-regex and syntax errors at runtime.
output.expectedBehavior: Generated Code-node JavaScript that contains escapes or regexes runs without syntax errors, and the agent avoids or verifies escape-sensitive constructs when embedding code in SDK source.
output.failurePattern: A regex was stripped to an invalid expression; the follow-up '\n\n' literal became real newlines causing SyntaxError, so one node needed three successive fixes.
output.proposedCheck: Build a Code node splitting text on newlines or a regex and verify the saved jsCode parses as valid JS with intact escapes.
output.openCodeNote: This node broke three times in a row on escaping and I had to paste the error back each time.
output.anchorDetail: Build Transcript Blocks Code node — jsCode escaping
